column3: NKJV includes “from the door,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “rolled away the stone.”
Close to the Greek; “appearance” is rendered “countenance.”
NKJV has “where the Lord lay,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “where He lay.”
NKJV begins “as they went to tell His disciples,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text begins “And behold, Jesus met them.” “Greetings” is rendered “Rejoice!”
NKJV ends with “Amen,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has no “Amen.”
